Kayn|jgl.identity: Physical damage fighter who picks his form mid-game. By hitting melee or ranged champions, Kayn fills a gauge that unlocks Rhaast (red form, a self-healing fighter, against melee teams) or the Shadow Assassin (blue form, burst and mobility, against ranged teams). Reaping Slash (Q) dashes while spinning, Blade's Reach (W) strikes in a line and slows, Shadow Step (E) lets him walk through walls, and Umbral Trespass (R) hides him inside a champion he has damaged before bursting out to deal damage.
Kayn|jgl.playstyle: Farming jungler who turns into a pressure jungler. Before his transformation, Kayn is weak: he farms and looks for easy skirmishes to fill his gauge. After it, he becomes either a very durable fighter (Rhaast) or a very mobile assassin (blue).
Kayn|jgl.early_game: Clear fast with Q and W, and Shadow Step (E) to move through walls and heal on camps. Gank when a laner can lock down the target: W to slow, Q, attacks. Every hit on a champion fills your gauge: join the easy fights.
Kayn|jgl.level_2: Shadow Step (E) or Blade's Reach (W) depending on your order. E lets you go through walls for surprise ganks.
Kayn|jgl.level_3: Full basic kit. Gank through walls with E, W to slow, Q to finish.
Kayn|jgl.level_6: Umbral Trespass: you hide inside a champion you recently damaged (you become untargetable), then burst out dealing damage. Use it to dodge a burst, finish a target or avoid a tower.
power_spikes: Transformation (red or blue): your real spike, between 10 and 15 minutes depending on fights.
Level 6: ultimate to dodge and finish.
First completed item: strong ganks and skirmishes.
Kayn|jgl.jungle_plan: Farm fast and join easy skirmishes to fill your gauge. Pick your form based on the enemy comp: Rhaast if the enemy team has lots of melee champions, the Shadow Assassin if it has lots of ranged carries. Use E for unexpected ganks through walls. Control Void Grubs (around 8 minutes) and dragons with your team.
Kayn|jgl.trading: Rhaast: Q → W (knock-up) → attacks, you heal off your damage. Blue: come through a wall with E, W → Q → R on the carry to dodge their counterattack. Give up on it against CC tanks before your transformation.
threats: Fiddlesticks, the only clearly bad matchup according to the data.
mistakes: Farming without joining fights and delaying your transformation.
Picking a form without looking at the enemy comp.
Using your ultimate too early, before the enemy burst.

matchup_notes.Lee Sin: He'll invade you before your transformation: avoid him.
matchup_notes.Viego: You both scale: be the first to transform.
matchup_notes.Graves: He steals your camps: keep vision.
matchup_notes.Wukong: His clone and knock-up bother you: wait for your transformation.
matchup_notes.Fiddlesticks: His ultimate destroys you when you dive: keep vision.

Kayn|jgl.mid_game: Dives and skirmishes around objectives. Use E to arrive from unexpected angles.
Kayn|jgl.late_game: Rhaast: dive into the enemy team and survive with your healing. Blue: assassinate the carry with R to dodge their counterattack.
Kayn|jgl.ahead: Choke out the enemy jungler, dive and take objectives.
Kayn|jgl.behind: Farm, transform and play with your team.
Kayn|jgl.win_condition: To win this game, you want to get your transformation quickly and dominate fights with the form that suits the enemy comp.
Kayn|jgl.final_tip: Join easy fights early: every hit on a champion brings your transformation closer.
